mapper.select: SELECT * FROM test_cases ORDER BY created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_cases WHERE platform = #{platform} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_cases WHERE app_id = #{appId} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
SELECT * FROM test_cases WHERE case_type = #{caseType} ORDER BY priority DESC, created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO test_cases (id, name, description, platform, app_id, case_type, steps, expected_result, priority, status, created_by, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{description}, #{platform}, #{appId}, #{caseType}, #{steps}, #{expectedResult}, #{priority}, #{status}, #{createdBy}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.update: UPDATE test_cases SET name = #{name}, description = #{description}, platform = #{platform}, app_id = #{appId}, case_type = #{caseType}, steps = #{steps}, expected_result = #{expectedResult}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
